title: Koffing 109/165 Reverse Holo MINT/NM Japanese Pokemon 151 Rare Pokeball
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Koffing card is a must-have for any Pokémon collector! With its rare 109/165 card number and Japanese language, this card is a valuable addition to your collection. The card features a reverse holo finish, making it a unique and sought-after item.

The card is from the Pokemon 151 set and has the attribute of being colorless. It is an ancient creature type and is not autographed. The card is manufactured by Nintendo and has features of being a chase card. Perfect for fans of the Pokémon TCG game, this Koffing card is sure to impress.
